scope: Independent read-only exact-source and retained-evidence review; no Go/build/test/capture/GitHub/poller/agents used in reviewer lane.

validated_guarantees.guarantee: At most16 selected exact child handles and leases survive complete inventory validation through mutation; other child handles close immediately. Initial names/digests schedule work and detect semantic changes, never authorize reopening old physical objects. Fresh exact-handle identity and namespace lease establish each later batch deletion authority.

Entire retained directory is checked before every batch first unlink, including canonical names, manifest decoding, frozen current view, binding validation, initial digest matching and presence of all still-pending candidates. Fresh current/held/registry protection can remove pending names. Initially protected names remain conservatively outside pending.

Post-segment root capture, write/rootReuse/store locks, current and both recovery-slot resources, held/prepared authority and existing same-parent quarantine/identity/sync sequence remain in force. No numeric-identity-only ABA reopening shortcut.

Initial census totals/protected/eligible/eligible bytes accumulate once; late protection changes actual deleted count without rewriting historical census. Durable deletion counts survive partial cancellation/failure, uncompleted selected leases/handles abort/close, and retries converge.
NativeEntries/NativeBytes preserve existing per-inventory footprint admission, independently rechecked for shrinking scans. No cumulative rescan-I/O quota is introduced.

limitations: Worst-case repeated complete scans cost O(N²/16); bounded descriptors trade extra explicit maintenance scan work. This is documented, not a measured capacity claim.

FD28 is sampled at BeforeRename, not a continuous global peak measurement. Static bound is16 retained selected handles plus one transient scan child; successful actual RLIMIT64 whole operation is the low-FD evidence.

First inventory names/digests do not continuously retain physical incarnations of unselected candidates. Each later batch obtains fresh physical authority; no stale original physical-object continuity is claimed.

Local exact-source review and retained Linux tests do not establish current-head hosted CI/review/retained C/A/D performance gates. Root must refresh affected evidence for the changed runtime; older095 success and the one-op smoke cannot substitute.
